title: Numeracy in Large Language Models: Fundamental Limitations and Paths to Improvement
abstract: arXiv:2608.13129v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) achieve strong results on mathematical reasoning benchmarks yet remain unreliable on elementary numerical tasks, including magnitude comparison, large-integer arithmetic, fractions, and scientific notation. This survey examines basic numerical understanding as a capability distinct from high-level mathematical reasoning. We propose the Numerical Grounding Framework (NGF), which decomposes numeracy into Representational Grounding (RG), mapping numeral forms to value, magnitude, and equivalent representations, and Procedural Grounding (PG), executing arithmetic operations in accordance with their mathematical definitions. Using NGF, we organize recent diagnostic benchmarks, failure modes, structural explanations, and mitigation strategies. We review evidence concerning tokenization, positional encoding, embedding geometry, and pretraining-data distribution. We also apply NGF in a coordinated evaluation of three

translated_title: 大型语言模型中的数感能力：根本局限与改进路径
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.13129v1 公告类型：新 摘要：大型语言模型（LLMs）在数学推理基准测试中取得了强劲结果，但在基本数值任务上仍不可靠，包括大小比较、大整数算术、分数和科学记数法。本综述将基本数值理解视为一种独立于高级数学推理的能力。我们提出了数值基础框架（NGF），该框架将数感能力分解为表示基础（RG），即映射数字形式到值、大小和等价表示，以及程序基础（PG），即根据数学定义执行算术运算。利用NGF，我们组织了最近的诊断基准、失败模式、结构性解释和缓解策略。我们审查了关于分词、位置编码、嵌入几何和预训练数据分布的证据。我们还应用NGF对三种模型进行了协调评估。
tldr: 本文提出数值基础框架（NGF），系统剖析大型语言模型在基本数值任务上的根本局限，并基于分词、编码和预训练数据等结构性因素探索改进路径。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Numerical Grounding Framework (NGF) to systematically analyze fundamental limitations of LLMs in basic numerical tasks and explores improvement paths based on structural factors like tokenization, encoding, and pretraining data.
